XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault warning light flashing, with car functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P1300 | WHEEL | SOUND | ON | IGNITION | LIGHTS UP | YELLOW | YELLOWS | FLASHES | FLASHING | MIL | ADJUSTMENTS | LEARNING | ADJUSTMENT | INCORRECT |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: The engine intermittently displays the engine fault light, while the vehicle continues to operate normally

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1300 (Phonic wheel learning required)

  • Cause: Incorrect phonic wheel parameter configuration

• Task: Use diagnostic equipment to adjust the phonic wheel

  • Procedure: The phonic wheel is calibrated as follows:
    • Bring the engine up to operating temperature.
    • Accelerate to 5000 rpm and maintain this speed for approximately 2 seconds
    • Leave the engine idling for a further 2 seconds
    • Repeat the acceleration sequence until the engine fault warning light goes out
    • The warning light usually goes out after the third repetition
  • Note: - -
